selection: First lexicographically listed video in the frozen evaluate26 cohort, chosen without outcomes.
purpose: Check whether missing observed boxes, covariance and actual assignment can be recovered from saved detector outputs without video decoding or model execution.
acceptance: All selected cases must reproduce exact current crops, observed prefix frame/crop history and last-observation support masks; predicted centers must meet the declared tolerance. No tolerance changes after the probe.
interpretation: A passing one-video probe permits considering a separately frozen export for other videos. A mismatch stops recovery and requires source/version investigation. It is not an identity improvement.
